description: Steady climb: gained, straight path (R² ≥ 0.8), never fell more than 30%
Bumpy climb: gained and ended within 10% of its high, with deeper wobbles
Rose then faded: gained, but ended more than 10% below its high
Round trip: was up 20% or more at some point, ended with a loss
Decline: lost money and was never up 20%
